reviews.title: Useless for streaming matches
reviews.text: It’s incredibly frustrating when trying to watch replay matches that you have to endure adverts at the start, then need to fast forward to where you think the match starts and be subjected to another 3 minutes of adverts to then find its not the right point so fast forward again and yet again be subjected to more adverts. It is the one reason why I hardly ever use this service. No thought to the consumers frustration.

reviews.title: Patchy, unreliable
reviews.text: Good sometimes, abjectly poor at others, with regular inconsistency. Live streaming is often a gamble (especially in Sports) to Chromecast and sometimes just stops. Latest versions of iOS, chromecast etc. at present streaming does not work.

reviews.title: Poor quality
reviews.text: Buffers all the time, shocking for 2026

reviews.title: STV Premier Sport App is useless
reviews.text: We frequently can’t get into Premier Sports which we paid for via STV player, using their app, but it often says we’re streaming in another device when we’re not! A total pain, do not pay for STV player, especially the Premier Sports App inside STV player

reviews.title: THE most out of date lagging app ever
reviews.text:
STV IPlayer need to up their game, I wish I could just watch everything I wanted to on ITV 
This app lags, sticks, can’t pause it. Continues to “play” in the background when I come out of the app
Only app I have this with, STV need to get into the 21st century 🙄

reviews.title: Worst TV App
reviews.text: Continuous glitches when on TV, fails to cast when on ipad and never fails to broadcast adverts rather than the show you actually want to watch. Try to avoid whenever possible.

reviews.title: App issues
reviews.text: Keeps freezing and then won’t resume.

reviews.title: Poor player
reviews.text: Love what’s on the player but it keeps crashing or I lose the sound on it and on my TV programmes

reviews.title: Can’t watch on tv, but could before
reviews.text: Can watch on phone fine, but the tv app won’t load.

reviews.title: Ads during rugby
reviews.text:
Putting ads in the middle of a game is shocking. Can’t enjoy anything without something being sold to you.

Digital adds on the pitch are so distracting and look terrible, why can’t they just paint it on the pitch like they used to?

reviews.title: Ad free version doesn’t work
reviews.text: Despite paying for the ad free version, it still doesn’t work. Tried uninstalling and reinstalling. Signing out and signing in. Contacted STV customer care team and and they couldn’t help. Really poor service and disappointing that their tech team couldn’t help. They wouldn’t issue a refund either as the subscription was paid through Apple. No other streaming service has issues like this for their upgraded membership. Extremely poor STV.

reviews.title: Useless
reviews.text:
This app is horrendous, buffers constantly. 
BBC iPlayer is far superior in stability and picture quality, I don’t know how they can get this so wrong!!
Trying to watch the world cup has been a chore, massive parts of the games missed while it buffers. 
The app needs fixed, but knowing that network, bet it has never been quality checked, like the news reporting.

reviews.title: Buffers with perfect connection
reviews.text: Pathetic excuse for a streaming service if watching on a mobile/laptop, gutting not to be able to watch the World Cup on the move unless BBC is showing it (a service that actually works). Not fit for purpose.

reviews.title: Sync issues
reviews.text: STV Player needs improvement with video and audio synchronisation. During World Cup matches, the sound and picture are sometimes out of sync, which makes the matches difficult to watch.

reviews.text: App doesn’t work on LG to

reviews.title: Terrible app
reviews.text: Terrible app. Buffering constantly. Uninstalled and won’t download again. BBC far better. Sadly the game I want to watch it on this app tonight

reviews.title: Adds
reviews.text: Too many adds makes the watching process difficult

reviews.title: Broadly poor quality
reviews.text: It’s easy to be kind about one bad quality app. But across web, iOS and Samsung tv all STV apps are just so badly made. UX, engineering, the whole thing is amateurish.

reviews.title: Murat
reviews.text: Is not working if is little slow internet

reviews.title: Pathetic
reviews.text: Absolutely awful app. Constant freezes and buffering. Unwatchable and STV should be embarrassed to put this app out. Very disappointed

reviews.title: Aweful
reviews.text: The app is terrible and it is impossible to get mobile app and firestick app to  link, also impossible to access STV player on firestick. The whole ITV/STV brand is terrible, you pay for no adds on ITVX but you get adds. The whole network is one big scam.

reviews.title: Casting doesn’t work properly
reviews.text: Literally everytime I want to use it, I cast it to the tv and it says it’s ready to cast, then when I click the video nothing happens. Seems to be an issue only on iPhone

reviews.title: Chromecast Premier sports is buggy
reviews.text: When trying to start chromecast, it gives an error about multiple devices. I’m not trying to play on multiplie devices at once, I just want to switch the stream from my phone to my television. Really frustrating when this happens during live sport

reviews.title: Not fit for purpose
reviews.text: I enjoy STV content but their app is unfit for purpose.  Surely a competent tech team could iron out the glitches?  Examples are adverts appearing even though I pay for ad-free.  Emails to STV support simply ask me to reinstall, then the adverts disappear onto to reappear. Few weeks later.  Another example is subtitles have to be manually turned off each time I enter the app. This is another regular error which needs a reinstall to fix then happens again and again.  Work urgently needs done to bring this app up to an acceptable standard.

reviews.title: STV player
reviews.text: Have had lots of problems with the app.  It doesn’t function correctly.  And why can’t all my devices - iPad and two tvs co-ordinate.  They never show the last episode of anything and all show different things.  Please improve it.

reviews.title: Pointless
reviews.text: Useless app, wont even go past Screen Two,  entered personal details and the Next button doesn’t work… what a total farce!

reviews.title: Ads, ads, ads
reviews.text: This app has been terrible recently, every time I rewind I get forced to watch ads even when I am scanning to find a specific point on a cooking show, I can get 3 sets of 3 minute ads over a 10 minute period! not gonna use this any more I will be deleting this app!  Life’s too short!

reviews.title: Carplay glitch
reviews.text: When using maps in carplay it pauses this app but won't restart after voice guidance

reviews.title: Useless
reviews.text: Now will not even open on an iPhone

reviews.title: Rubbish
reviews.text: Utterly awful app.  Wouldn’t even let me put my postcode in to confirm I live in the area.  I hope you didn’t pay someone to make this.  Utter garbage!

reviews.title: Very poor
reviews.text:
The app for Smart TV’s is terrible. Unable to watch live TV due to picture freezing entirely or, sound dropping every 3 seconds. All other apps work on the TV perfectly. 

No ability to ‘watch from start’ for live shows as you can with the BBC iPlayer. 

Also deeply frustrating the lack of clarity what you have to watch on this rather than the ITV app which works well (apart from when you select a channel you can’t view becuase you’re in Scotland, it doesn’t tell you - just lets you select the show and puts you on a different channel). 

Hopeless.

reviews.title: God awful app
reviews.text: Doesn’t have basic functionality like ‘continue watching’ for a series. Add to watchlist dos not work. App is buggy constantly requires restarting. Same for Apple TV app. I would use ITV app if I could but some things not on there

reviews.title: Literally just doesn’t work…
reviews.text: Genius decision from the developers to create an app that doesn’t open

reviews.title: Someone is fixing the ratings
reviews.text: So bad. Full of bugs how does this get good ratings. The most frustrating app ever.

reviews.text: App crashes before it even opens lol

reviews.title: Radio not loading
reviews.text: The radio part of the app isn’t working when I press it there isn’t anything I waited a few minutes but nothing.

reviews.title: Once a month
reviews.text: I find the STV player OK, however, once a month around about the time that they take my subscription, the app reverts to free with ads. Sometimes, this can take a week to get sorted by which time you have lost a weeks paid without ads. Over a year this all adds up.

reviews.title: Passwords
reviews.text: So like a lot of people my phone offers me passwords and after I log in apps remember me well not stv player I have to constantly re login and of course it’s a long convoluted password doing this every time I want to use the service is irritating

reviews.title: Crash
reviews.text: This app has to be the most glitchy TV app I’ve ever encountered, just freezes mid-episode, you go back to the menu, show’s disappeared off of your list, doesn’t keep track of what episode you’re up to half the time so if you’re watching a long series you’ll forever lose track of where you are… highly disappointing considering it’s the only place to watch Shortland Street in the UK 😮‍💨

reviews.title: Buggy
reviews.text: The most buggy app I’ve ever known, keeps saying sorry you are offline when I try to watch live local news, every single other app works perfectly including live tv on other channels.. when STV scraps Aberdeen news, I will just dump the app and stop watching Glasgow based STV who are completely out of touch with rest of Scotland

reviews.title: Terrible app
reviews.text:
It’s slow, it constantly stops working where you can’t get out of it, can’t pause, can’t rewind etc. Doesn’t properly record progress of watching a show to pick up later.

Just TERRIBLE!

reviews.title: Keeps dropping my account
reviews.text: I have signed up for annual add free. Now having to watch adds and customer support contacted twice through email and directly through app acknowledging receipt of my issue but no response 5 days later. The strange thing is it was fine up until now and only get adds on my iPad and iPhone. TV app is ok. Please address this issue as not happy having to pay for something I can’t use when not sitting in front of my TV.

reviews.title: This is the worst app ever
reviews.text: I have never come across such a poor app as this. Although a family member has had a paid subscription to remove ads, after a week or so it reverts to a “free” account and nothing brings the paid subscription back. We went to the trouble of cancelling the subscription, deleting the account with STV, creating a new account and resubscribing. All fine for a couple of weeks until today - back to “free” although the subscription is still active. We contacted STV and they sent. Link to cancel!! They really don’t care. Couple all this with content that vanishes and poor casting to TV, and it really is bad. I would say avoid!!

reviews.title: Just awful
reviews.text: This is the worst app for tv programmes ever. I only ever watch I’m a Celebrity and every year the app has been an issue. Maybe it’s lack of investment because it’s Scotland. I’m fed up of it being rubbish. In 2025 and so many good alternatives they need to up their game.

reviews.title: The app is awful. Don’t bother
reviews.text:
No itv on skygo, so you have to download ITVX. You go to ITVX app to watch ITV but because you’re north of the border you have to download stv player. You download this and all you get is “give us money to watch sport”. I was trying to watch a free to air programme but to do this you have to download 40 apps and subscribe to 50!!
Probably only missed 6 minutes of programming and 24 minutes of ads anyhow!!

reviews.title: Glitches and crashes every time I try to watch anything.
